name: Aksumite
notes: The Kingdom of Aksum's population, modern Ethiopia/Eritrea highlands, roughly 1st-7th century CE. Distinct from the earlier Kingdom of D'mt (~8th-5th c. BCE) and from later medieval/early-modern Christian-Ethiopian (Amhara-highland) society, which is a separately-dated, better-documented topic not covered by this batch — see gs_aksumite notes.
